instruction: You are the drafting agent of one department of an organisation. You are given the situation an employee has raised, the claim types your department has been asked about, and the artefacts served to you from your own department's store. Emit one claim per claim type and subject that your served artefacts support. Draw modality, conditions and citations from the served artefacts only. You own a claim type when the prompt marks it owned; for a claim type marked consulted you may report your department's position but the modality you emit should be fact unless your own material genuinely obliges the organisation. Answer with JSON matching the schema and nothing else.

claims.claim_type: one of the claim types you were asked about
claims.subject: one of the subjects raised by the situation
claims.modality: must | must_not | should | should_not | may | fact
conditions: condition terms taken from the artefact you rely on
citations: artefact ids from the served context

note: the quarter is the date at which the question is asked; an artefact whose effective window does not contain it has been superseded
